defs.def: very impressive or very difficult and perhaps rather frightening 令人惊叹的；使人惊惧的；很困难的；难得吓人的

ex.s: There is a lot to explore on your hikes: breathtaking mountains, awesome glaciers, crashing waterfalls and black sand beaches.
ex.t: 在你的徒步之旅中有很多可探索的：令人叹为观止的山脉、壮观的冰川、奔腾的瀑布和黑色的沙滩。

defs.def: very good, enjoyable, etc. 很好的（或极好玩的等）

ex.s: “Well, it’s pretty awesome, isn’t it?” he replied.
ex.t: “嗯，这挺棒的，不是吗？”他回答道。

ex.s: I called out:  “You guys are awesome!” One woman waved back, “Come and join us!
ex.t: 我喊道："你们太棒了！"一位女士挥手回应："来加入我们吧！

ex.s: He made one for me with my name in Chinese-pretty awesome!
ex.t: 他还给我做了一个带我中文名字的——真不错！

ex.s: Well I just got back from a week of simulated manned flight activities, and it was awesome!
ex.t: 我刚结束为期一周的模拟载人飞行活动回来，真是太棒了！

ex.s: Looking at the beautiful scenery, they both agreed that it was the most awesome journey they had ever taken.
ex.t: 看着美丽的风景，他们都认为这是他们经历过的最棒的旅程。
